metadata.description: Font registration via @font, canvas inheritance, standalone SVG Base64 embedding, and Photopea synchronization

standalone_svg_base64.description: SVG exporter automatically converts local .ttf/.otf binaries into Base64 data URLs inside @font-face defs, ensuring 100% portable vector rendering without system font fallbacks.

photopea_fonts_synchronization.rule: Do NOT create separate local 'fonts/' folders per project. All font binaries (.ttf/.otf) must be stored in and referenced from the central repository at 'c:/toad-designs/fonts/'. When a new font is needed, add it to 'c:/toad-designs/fonts/'.
photopea_fonts_synchronization.workflow: Enables users to drag and drop all fonts into Photopea or Photoshop once from a single central folder so PSD Type Layers render natively without missing font alerts or substitution distortion.
